one_line: The paper applies an ANN-based energy management model (aligned with ISO 50001) to real operational data from Italian combined-cycle thermal power plants to improve energy baselines, focusing on a cooling tower fan sub-unit; the context is electricity generation, not any of the eight listed Corpus B sectors.
